newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in to slow won's fall - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in to slow won's fall - dealers.

text.p: South Korea's central bank sold dollars at around 892 won in the interbank market on Monday to slow the won's fall, dealers said.
The won quickly rebounded to around 891.30 won per dollar after the intervention in mid-afternoon trading, they said.
Officials at the central bank, the Bank of Korea, were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said the won was approaching the day's low of 892.40 when the central bank intervened.
They said the local currency had faced downward pressure recently in the wake of effective currency devaluations in Thailand and the Philippines.
